help.title: Help
help.visionDesc: Let AI be your conversion expert - Say goodbye to tedious parameter tuning. Just choose your goal (extreme compression/visual lossless/balanced), and AI will automatically optimize all parameters based on each image's characteristics (texture complexity, color distribution, transparency, etc.).
help.modernFormats: Embrace Modern Formats - Default recommendation of next-generation formats like AVIF, JXL, WebP, reducing file size by 30-50% at the same quality, making your resource library lighter. Also supports advanced features like HDR, animation, and transparency.
help.smartUpgrade: Smart Format Upgrade - When detecting traditional formats like JPEG/PNG, AI evaluates upgrade benefits (compression improvement, feature enhancement) and recommends modern formats at the right time, making every conversion worthwhile.
help.metadataDesc: All metadata is automatically preserved without any configuration:
help.metadataExif: EXIF Camera Info - Shooting parameters, GPS location, device model
help.metadataXmp: XMP Edit History - Photoshop/Lightroom edit records
help.metadataIcc: ICC Color Profile - Color space and profile
help.metadataXmpMerge: XMP Sidecar Merge - Automatically merge external XMP files using exiftool
help.metadataEagle: Eagle Resource Info - Tags, ratings, notes synced
help.metadataTimestamp: File Timestamps - Creation/modification/access times fully preserved
help.metadataExtended: Extended Attributes - macOS xattr, Windows ADS automatically preserved
help.imageFeature1: Smart Parameter Prediction - AI analyzes image features and automatically selects optimal parameters
help.imageFeature2: AI File Validation - Uses Google Magika to detect file types and prevent disguised files
help.imageFeature3: SSIM Quality Validation - Automatically validates quality loss after conversion
help.imageFeature4: GPU Hardware Acceleration - Automatically detects and uses GPU acceleration (5-20x speed boost)
help.imageFeature5: Smart Preprocessing - Automatically optimizes images (denoising, sharpening, color correction)
help.imageFeature6: Format Auto-Correction - Detects if file extension matches actual format, automatically identifies disguised files (e.g., .jpg is actually .png)
help.videoFeature1: Animation to Video Recommendation - Detects large animations (GIF/APNG/WebP), intelligently recommends converting to video format (MP4/WebM), reducing size by 60-80%
help.videoFeature2: Scene Detection - Intelligently detects scene changes and optimizes keyframe distribution
help.videoFeature3: VMAF Quality Validation - Uses Netflix VMAF algorithm to validate video quality
help.videoFeature4: Two-Pass Encoding - Two-pass encoding optimizes bitrate allocation, reducing size by 10-20% at the same quality
